第一卷 第7章 全场哗然百年天才（第1页）
原本初入炼气一层的粗浅根基，被彻底打磨圆满。
体内淤积百年的经脉杂质，被精纯灵气冲刷十之三四。
肉身衰败、气血枯竭的状态，得到极大改善。
他能清晰感觉到，自己的身体一日强过一日。
只要愿意，借助古卷提纯丹药，他随时可以瞬间破境。
这日清晨，清脆的传召之声响彻整片外门。
“所有外门弟子，即刻前往前山广场集合！不得延误！”
苏玄尘收起古卷，整理好灰布弟子衣衫，推门而出。
一路前行，山道之上，无数外门弟子络绎汇聚。
少年、青年居多，个个朝气蓬勃、意气风发。
唯独他一人白发佝偻，行走其中，格格不入。
沿途无数目光扫来，好奇、轻视、戏谑、不解。
百岁修仙的消息，短短三日，早已传遍整个外门。
所有人都知道，青玄宗收了一位史无前例的高龄弟子。
多数人只当是宗门一时糊涂，收了个无用老朽。
少数人听过些许风声，知晓这老者似乎真的引气入体成功，更是心生诧异。
“那就是那个百岁老头？居然还在修炼？”
“真是离谱，活这么大岁数，不好等死，凑什么仙门热闹。”
“听说赵师兄前两天去找麻烦，居然没占到便宜？”
“真的假的？一个老朽还能打过炼气四层？”
百年流言蜚语、人情冷暖，他早已看透。
旁人讥笑嘲讽，于他道心，毫无动摇。
不多时，他随人流抵达外门大广场。
数百外门弟子整齐站立，黑压压一片。
广场前方高台，数名青衫执事肃立，气场威严。
片刻后，为首一名中年执事踏前一步，目光扫过全场。
“今日召集全体外门弟子，宣布两件宗门要事。”
所有人目光紧紧望向高台，满心期待。
“第一件，三日后，开启【青峦外门秘境试炼】。”
“所有炼气一层及以上弟子，皆可报名参与。”
“秘境之内，盛产灵石、灵药、低级灵材，机缘无数。”
“试炼排名靠前弟子，可获宗门丹药、功法、积分重赏！”
话音落下，全场瞬间爆发出一片哗然狂喜！
“这是我们外门最好的翻身机会！”
“必须报名！拼死也要多捞点资源！”
这是外门弟子为数不多、可以快速获取资源、崭露头角的机会。
高台之上，执事抬手压下喧闹，继续开口。
话音微微一顿，目光陡然扫向人群角落的苏玄尘。
全场所有人的目光，不由自主跟着偏移过去。
“近日巡仙下山，破格收录一位绝世仙苗。”
“此人资质，千年难遇，乃是我青州百年未见的——极品天灵根！”
“他便是，新晋外门弟子——苏、玄、尘！”
一句话，如同惊雷炸响在广场上空！
所有人瞳孔骤缩，满脸骇然、难以置信！

Volume 1 Chapter 7 The whole audience was in an uproar: A century-old genius (Page 1)
The rough foundation that originally entered the first level of Qi Refining was completely polished and perfected.
Three out of ten impurities accumulated in the meridians in the body for hundreds of years were washed away by the pure spiritual energy.
The state of physical decay and Qi and blood depletion has been greatly improved.
He could clearly feel that his body was getting stronger day by day.
As long as he is willing, he can break through the realm instantly at any time with the help of ancient scrolls to purify the elixir.
In the early morning of this morning, the clear voice of summons resounded throughout the outer gate.
"All outer disciples, gather at Qianshan Square immediately! No delay!"
Su Xuanchen put away the ancient scrolls, arranged the gray cloth disciple's clothes, and pushed out the door.
Along the way, countless outer disciples gathered on the mountain road.
There are mostly teenagers and young people, all of whom are full of energy and high spirits.
He was the only one with white hair and rickets, and he looked out of place when walking among them.
Along the way, countless eyes glanced at me, showing curiosity, contempt, teasing, and confusion.
The news of the hundred-year-old cultivating immortality had already spread throughout the outer sect in just three days.
Everyone knows that Qingxuan Sect has accepted an unprecedented senior disciple.
Most people just thought that the sect was temporarily confused and accepted a useless old man.
A few people had heard some rumors and were even more surprised to know that the old man seemed to have succeeded in drawing Qi into his body.
"Is that that centenary old man? Still practicing?"
"It's really outrageous. It's hard to wait for death at such an old age and join in the fun of the immortal sect."
"I heard that Senior Brother Zhao went to find trouble two days ago, but he didn't get any advantage?"
"Really? Can an old man pass the fourth level of Qi Refining?"
He has already seen through hundreds of years of rumors and rumors, and the warmth and warmth of human relationships.
Others laughed and ridiculed him, but his Taoist heart was not shaken.
Not long after, he followed the crowd and arrived at the outer gate square.
Hundreds of outer sect disciples stood in order, surrounded by darkness.
On the high platform in front of the square, several deacons in blue shirts stood solemnly with a majestic aura.
After a moment, the first middle-aged deacon took a step forward and glanced across the audience.
"Today we summon all the outer disciples to announce two important matters for the sect."
Everyone looked closely at the high platform, full of expectations.
"The first thing is, three days later, the [Qingluan Outer Sect Secret Realm Trial] will be opened."
"All disciples at level 1 and above of Qi Refining can sign up to participate."
"The secret realm is rich in spiritual stones, elixirs, and low-level spiritual materials. There are countless opportunities."
"The top disciples in the trial will be rewarded with sect elixirs, techniques, and points!"
As soon as the words fell, the entire audience burst into an uproar and ecstasy!
“This is our outer door’s best chance to turn around!”
"You must sign up! You must work hard to get more resources!"
This is one of the few opportunities for outer sect disciples to quickly obtain resources and make their mark.
On the high platform, the deacon raised his hand to suppress the noise and continued to speak.
After a slight pause in his words, his eyes suddenly glanced at Su Xuanchen in the corner of the crowd.
The eyes of everyone present involuntarily turned away.
"Recently, the Immortal Patrol came down the mountain, and a peerless Immortal Seedling was included in the special collection."
"This person's qualifications are rare to find in a thousand years, and he is something I have not seen in Qingzhou for a hundred years - the best heavenly spirit root!"
"He is the new outer disciple - Su, Xuan and Chen!"
In one sentence, it was like thunder exploding over the square!
Everyone's pupils shrank suddenly, their faces full of shock and disbelief!
